# Token Budget Router

> Route AI tasks across model classes and context strategies using explicit quality, latency, privacy and token-cost constraints. Use when an agent system needs a deterministic model-selection plan instead of always choosing the largest model.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/qasimrazamalik-coder/token-budget-router
License: MIT
Primary instructions: skill/SKILL.md
Installation: docs/INSTALLATION.md
Safety guardrails: docs/GUARDRAILS.md
Security policy: SECURITY.md
Example input: examples/input.json

## Supported runtimes
Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, MCP-compatible agents, and custom agent runtimes.

## Usage
Run: python skill/scripts/run.py examples/input.json
Test: pytest -q
